operating_notes.text: Acquired select assets from Soho Dragon Solutions India with estimated annual revenue of $4.9M for up to $5.94M consideration.
FY26 exceptional item of ₹890.25 million is the statutory impact of new Labour Codes, with restructured compensation effective April 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 segment revenue: BFSI ₹1,396.28 Cr, Healthcare & Life Sciences ₹1,066.28 Cr, Software Hi-Tech & Emerging ₹1,593.38 Cr.
Standalone FY26 other income includes gains of ₹556.50 million (Germany) and ₹25.97 million (France) on transfer of subsidiaries to Aepona Group Limited, Ireland.
Q4FY26 total headcount reached 27,502 employees with a TTM attrition rate of 13.0%.
NCLT Mumbai order dated April 21, 2026 sanctions the merger of wholly owned subsidiary Arrka Infosec Private Limited into Persistent Systems Limited; certified copy of the order awaited.
Persistent is a Databricks Global Systems Integrator partner at Silver Tier with more than 900 certifications and a growing accelerator portfolio on the Databricks Data Intelligence platform.

PerSys Estonia OÜ, incorporated April 2026 and headquartered in Estonia, was acquired for EUR 10,000 cash as a wholly owned subsidiary of Aepona Group Limited to expand Persistent's technology services footprint in Europe; turnover not appl
Persistent is Kong's global systems integration partner, combining Kong's AI Gateway and unified API/AI connectivity platform with Persistent's GenAI Hub; no deal value disclosed.
Persistent has over 27,500 employees in 21 countries, per the press release.
Persistent Systems is acquiring part of Concise Systems OÜ's business through PerSys Estonia OÜ for EUR 5.6M with estimated annual revenue of EUR 11.6M.

Persistent to integrate a team of more than 90 professionals from Tallinn-based Concise, establishing delivery centres in Tallinn and Tartu, Estonia, subject to closing conditions; no value disclosed.
Promoters and promoter group held 47,789,930 equity shares of ₹5 each, 30.29% of the company, as of 31 March 2026, with no encumbrance during FY26.

MediaAgility India Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary being merged into Persistent, had turnover of ₹365.55 million (₹36.56 Cr) as of March 31, 2026, against Persistent's ₹144,279.59 million (₹14,428 Cr).

Persistent Systems UK Limited is to move from Persistent Systems Limited, India to Aepona Group Limited, Ireland, becoming its wholly owned subsidiary, upon execution of an SPA; benefit to promoters stated as Nil.
Nagarro CY25 EBIT margin 10.9%, Q1CY26 12.1%; EBITDA margin 13.9%.
Combined entity: $2.9 bn revenue, 46,000+ employees, 40+ countries; North America 62%, Europe 22%, RoW 16%.
New $650 mn deal is net new, end-to-end product engineering and support for a significant portfolio of products globally, accretive from Q2.
Record quarterly TCV of $1.15 billion in Q1FY27, including a $650 million deal with a leading global technology company
Top 10 clients contributed 43.0% of revenue in Q1FY27, stable vs 42.1% in Q4FY26
Utilization including trainees was 86.5% in Q1FY27 vs 88.0% in Q4FY26
Offer Document for Nagarro SE takeover submitted to BaFin for approval.
Minimum Acceptance Threshold condition under Section 12.1.1 of Offer Document for Nagarro SE fulfilled as of 17 September 2026.
EGM considered enabling resolutions for borrowing up to USD 1,250 million and issuing securities up to USD 450 million.
Secured 94.04% of Nagarro SE outstanding shares post additional offer period as of 6 October 2026.
ICRA assigned [ICRA]AA+; Rating Watch with Negative Implications to proposed ₹5,000 Cr NCDs and continued Issuer Rating on watch.
Standalone other expenses nearly doubled to ₹910 Cr in Q2FY27 from ₹470 Cr a year ago, far ahead of 29% revenue growth.
Standalone H1FY27 operating cash flow was ₹662 Cr against ₹871 Cr a year ago, with billed receivables at ₹2,289 Cr on 30 September 2026.
The company held 94.04% of Nagarro SE as of 6 October 2026, including 10.79% from the additional acceptance period.
Q2FY27 TTM ACV bookings $1,964.8M; TTM TCV $3,055.1M.
Top 5 client concentration rose to 38.1% in Q2FY27 from 33.2% in Q1FY27.
Utilisation including trainees fell to 85.8% in Q2FY27 from 86.5% in Q1FY27; attrition TTM 11.9%.

QIP floor price ₹5,550 per share, issue size up to USD 450 million (₹4,265 Cr), relevant date October 21, 2026; book running lead managers J. P. Morgan India, IIFL Capital Services and HSBC Securities and Capital Market (India).

Assigned CRISIL AA+ with Rating Watch with Developing Implications for proposed ₹7,000 Cr NCDs.
Q2FY27 headcount reached 29,598 with utilization at 85.8%.

timeline.summary: Entered Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire select assets of Soho Dragon Solutions India for $5.94M.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,055.94 Cr (+25.1% YoY), net profit ₹529.26 Cr (+33.7% YoY).
Board of Directors, led by Amit Atre (ICSI A20507), recommended ₹18 final dividend per share (₹5 face value) for FY 2025-26, pending AGM approval.
Persistent Systems Limited shared the **Q4FY26 investor/analyst call outcome and audio recording** on April 21, 2026, via its website, as mandated by SEBI.
2026-04-22: NCLT Mumbai sanctioned, by order dated April 21, 2026, the merger of wholly owned subsidiary Arrka Infosec Private Limited into Persistent Systems Limited.
Persistent Systems Limited held a Non-Deal Roadshow on April 23, 2026, meeting HDFC Life Insurance, HDFC Mutual Fund, and 11 other investors to reiterate Q4FY26 earnings call details.

Persistent Systems Limited’s **Amit Atre** (Company Secretary) informed exchanges of a one-on-one investor session with **Mirabilis Investment Trust** on April 27, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST, reiterating Q4FY26 earnings call details without new updates.
Persistent Systems Limited held one-on-one virtual investor sessions with Bellwether Capital and American Century Investments on May 5, 2026, reiterating Q4FY26 earnings call details.

2026-05-07: Persistent said it achieved the Databricks Brickbuilder Specialization for Healthcare and Life Sciences, citing 900+ Databricks certifications and Silver Tier partner status, with no financial terms.

2026-05-11: Persistent received the certified true copy of the NCLT Mumbai order sanctioning the merger of wholly owned subsidiary Arrka Infosec Private Limited into the company, with no shares allotted and an appointed date of April 1, 2025.
Persistent Systems Limited’s **Amit Atre** (ACS 20507) held a one-to-one investor session with Nalanda Capital on May 15, 2026, reiterating Q4FY26 earnings call details without new updates.
Persistent Systems Limited’s **Amit Atre** (ICSI ACS 20507) met William Blair Investment Management on May 19, 2026, to reiterate Q4FY26 earnings call details without new disclosures.

2026-05-25: Persistent announced a strategic partnership making it Kong's global systems integration partner, pairing Kong's AI Gateway with Persistent's GenAI Hub for governed enterprise AI; no value disclosed.
On May 28, 2026, Persistent Systems announced that its step-down subsidiary PerSys Estonia OÜ agreed to acquire part of Concise Systems OÜ for EUR 5.6M.

2026-06-01: Persistent signed an agreement, subject to closing conditions, to integrate a team of more than 90 professionals from Tallinn-based Concise, establishing delivery centres in Tallinn and Tartu, Estonia; no value disclosed.
Persistent Systems Limited’s **Amit Atre** (ICSI ACS 20507) met **Aikya Investment Management** on June 2, 2026, to reiterate Q4FY26 earnings call details without new disclosures.
2026-06-05: Persistent's promoters declared a 30.29% (47,789,930 shares) holding at 31 March 2026 with no share encumbrance during FY26, under SAST Regulation 31(4).

2026-06-08: Persistent's board approved transferring 100% of Persistent Systems UK Limited to Aepona Group Limited, Ireland as an internal restructuring, to be done upon execution of a Share Purchase Agreement; no value or promoter benefit stated.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,303.23 Cr (+29.1% YoY), net profit ₹483.04 Cr (+13.7% YoY).
Persistent Systems reported Q1FY27 results with 29.1% YoY revenue growth to ₹4,303 Cr and announced a Business Combination Agreement with Nagarro.
Persistent shareholders approved the proposed takeover of Nagarro SE via Galaxy Germany Holding SE.
Persistent Systems Limited’s 36th AGM (Aug 3, 2026) passed 12 resolutions unanimously, including standalone and consolidated financial statements adoption.
Persistent Systems launched a public takeover offer for all Nagarro SE shares at EUR 81.00 per share, representing a ~140% premium to the June 25, 2026 closing price.
Board approved enabling resolutions to raise up to USD 1,250 million via debt and equity instruments.
Fulfilled minimum acceptance threshold for the public takeover offer of Nagarro SE following expiry of acceptance period.
Persistent Systems announced a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Nagarro SE at EUR 81 per share in cash, implying an enterprise value of ~₹1,270 Cr.
Persistent secures 83.25% of Nagarro SE, exceeding the 50% threshold, and sets a target to delist by Q1 CY27.
Persistent Systems conducted an EGM to approve an increase in borrowing limits up to $1,250M and securities issuance up to $450M.
EGM held on 5 Oct 2026 approved the increase in borrowing limits to USD 1,250 million and securities issuance to USD 450 million.
Secured 94.04% aggregate shareholding in Nagarro SE following the additional acceptance period ending 6 October 2026.
ICRA assigned [ICRA]AA+ (Rating Watch Negative) to proposed ₹5,000 Cr NCDs and reaffirmed Issuer Rating.
On 15 October 2026; with prior periods restated for ESOP trust consolidation and the Arrka merger.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,663.9 Cr (+30.3% YoY), net profit ₹351.51 Cr (-25.4% YoY).
Persistent Systems approved the terms of issuance of up to ₹8,000 Cr in NCDs and ₹1,000 Cr in Commercial Paper for the acquisition of Nagarro SE.
On October 21, 2026, Persistent's Special Committee opened a QIP of up to USD 450 million (₹4,265 Cr) at a floor price of ₹5,550 per share.
Persistent Systems updated the floor price for its QIP issue to ₹5,761.00 per share.
Crisil assigned CRISIL AA+ with Rating Watch with Developing Implications to the proposed ₹7,000 Cr NCDs on October 21, 2026.
On October 15, 2026, Persistent Systems reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹4,664 Cr, up 30.3% YoY, with an EBIT margin of 15%.
Persistent Systems approved the allocation of 76,83,981 equity shares at ₹5,550 per share to raise ₹4,264.61 Cr via QIP.
